mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT venue.id) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT venue.id) FILTER (WHERE venue.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active, COUNT(DISTINCT venue.id) FILTER (WHERE venue.status = 'ARCHIVED') AS archived, COUNT(DISTINCT section.id) AS sections, COUNT(seat.id) AS seats FROM venues venue LEFT JOIN venue_sections section ON section.venue_id = venue.id LEFT JOIN seats seat ON seat.section_id = section.id
SELECT currency, SUM(total_amount) AS amount, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

SELECT event.id AS event_id, event.name, venue.name AS venue_name, event.start_time, event.sales_end_time, event.status, COUNT(event_seat.id) AS seats_total, COUNT(event_seat.id) FILTER (WHERE event_seat.permanent_status = 'SOLD') AS seats_sold FROM events event JOIN venues venue ON venue.id = event.venue_id LEFT JOIN event_seats event_seat ON event_seat.event_id = event.id WHERE event.start_time >= #{now} AND event.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PUBLISHED') GROUP BY event.id, event.name, venue.name, event.start_time, event.sales_end_time, event.status ORDER BY event.start_time ASC, event.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
